Windows.Comment: Windows provider assumes supported SAPI voices are installed on the system. Example: Microsoft George (en), Microsoft Hazel (en), Microsoft Susan (en), Microsoft Heidi (fi), Microsoft An (vi)

PiperCache.Comment: Directory: where the piper engine and voice models are cached; null or empty keeps the default (the application working directory). CacheTtlDays: reuse a cached engine or voice model for this many days before downloading and extracting it again (14 = two weeks); 0 or a negative value keeps cached assets forever.
